changes.title: Flask stack bigger
items: The flask in your stack is half again as big, so it reads at a glance

changes.title: Heavies shooters
items: Shooters' shots fly faster and further at you, so walking away no longer takes you out of reach: change direction or blink

Boars, elk, rams, stags, bears and herons are slow to get going but faster than you once they're up to speed, and their charges swing after you: a quick burst or a blink gets clear, a long retreat gets run down

changes.title: Pulse speed
items: The ley pulse now travels at a steady speed along the line, and each wave comes as it reaches the next runestone: short links bring waves quickly, long ones give you longer
The speaker boot-up runs at the same speed, about 45 seconds
The Waves menu in your room now picks the pulse's speed: slow, normal, fast or off
